blocks.label: Opening
blocks.guidance: Acknowledge the recent event in one clean sentence as the reason for writing now.

blocks.label: Body
blocks.guidance: Acknowledge their stage and the need to scale commercial efforts. Position as a generalist who can build the engine, backed by one quantified proof point.

blocks.label: Positioning
blocks.text: I'm at Sciences Po this year looking for a part-time seat to build inside a company rather than evaluate from the outside.

blocks.label: Close
blocks.text: If you have any time in the next week or two, I'd love to talk about how I might be able to help the team.

style.notes: Confident, generalist operator tone. Focus on building the GTM engine.
